what_to_detect: An attackers record listing as a legal attacker a creature that is summoning sick and has haste.
near_miss: An attackers record excluding a summoning-sick creature that has no haste.

what_to_detect: A decision candidate with a {T} in its cost, whose source is summoning sick and has haste, that can be played.
near_miss: A candidate with a {T} cost whose summoning-sick source has no haste, which cannot be played.
record_fields: snapshot summoning_sick and keywords of the source
